Setting.name: identityStatusAttribute
Setting.label: Identity status attribute
Setting.helpText: Identity attribute holding the lifecycle status. Default: status (PreHire / Active / Terminated, set by the rule HR Lifecycle - Status Attribute). Leave blank to use the IdentityIQ Inactive flag (Active / Inactive).

Setting.name: inactiveStatusValues
Setting.label: Inactive status values
Setting.helpText: Comma separated status values whose accounts should be disabled. Case-insensitive.

Setting.name: excludedApplications
Setting.label: Excluded applications
Setting.helpText: Comma separated application names to leave out of the dashboard.

Setting.name: cacheSeconds
Setting.label: Cache seconds
Setting.helpText: How long a computed snapshot is reused before recalculating. 0 disables the cache.

Setting.name: maxMismatchRows
Setting.label: Max mismatch rows
Setting.helpText: Maximum number of mismatched accounts listed on the page. Counts are always complete.
